provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10. Limits: the terminology calls' rates are declared; TranslateText's and TranslateDocument's are not published. A text holds at most 10,000 bytes (UTF-8), a document 100 KB and 100,000 characters, English on one side; 100 terminologies a region (adjustable), 20 MB each, 256 terms used by TranslateText, one terminology a translation. Throttling answers 400 (TooManyRequestsException), not 429: a ProviderException the registry falls back past. Free tier: 2,000,000 characters a month of standard text translation for 12 months from the first request; none for real-time document translation. No plans are declared: the quotas page (read again on 2026-11-10) states the same quotas for every account, with no tier, and the free tier is a price for the first year, not a limit the API applies. Attribution: not required; AWS suggests attributing translations to machine translation. Data retention: Amazon may store and use text inputs to provide, maintain and improve Amazon Translate and other Amazon machine-learning technologies, possibly in another region; an AWS Organizations AI services opt-out policy stops it, and AWS Support deletes what was stored on request. Commercial use: no restriction stated in the pages read, hence unknown.
